caption: The drawing depicts a relief sculpture showing a cannon with two large spoked wheels, on top of which is perched a bird facing to the right. The cannon is oriented to the right and appears to be partially embedded in the rectangular stone block that serves as the background. To the left of the cannon, several cannonballs are depicted, and various mechanical parts, such as chains or hooks, are also visible along the carriage. The background features etched or engraved lines suggesting texture or stonework. The entire composition is rendered in shades of gray and muted blue, giving the appearance of a stone or metallic relief, with some cross-hatching and line work to indicate shadow and depth. The drawing is presented on a plain, light tan or beige sheet, with a double-line rectangular border and a small rectangle with measurements in the upper right corner outside the main image area.
title: Bas Relief
